processNotes: The routing is inferred; no historical routing was supplied.

The manufactured frame components and fork are assumed available as completed components. Exact geometry, joint locations, heat treatment, finish details and fork-retention hardware are not established by the supplied BOM.
The diagram is schematic, especially for the four seat stays; it does not establish their precise arrangement.
variantNotes: The representative product is Silver, size 42. Silver and Black variants are listed in sizes 38, 42, 44, 46 and 48.
All listed variants have the same direct BOM components and quantities except paint: Silver uses Paint - Silver PA-529S, 8.00 OZ; Black uses Paint - Black PA-187B, 8.00 OZ.
The Silver size 48 variant is listed as FR-M94S-52. Its stated size and product number are reproduced as supplied, without resolving the mismatch.
The BOM does not specify size-dependent component geometry or additional substitutions; do not assume the size 42 assembly geometry applies to other sizes.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.
Clarified identification of Top Tube; retained the source part number in the point-of-use checklist.
Moved variant-selection notes ahead of the first operation to reduce wrong-kit changeovers.
Aligned component count checks with the bill of materials and removed a duplicate sign-off box.
Reformatted shop-floor copies for clearer numbered steps and consolidated inspection comments.
Released the illustrated workstation edition: Schematic frame and fork relationship. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100051.title: Schematic frame and fork relationship
guidance: Position 1.00 EA of Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), 1.00 EA of Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828), 1.00 EA of Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377) and 1.00 EA of Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019) in an assumed frame assembly jig.
Position 2.00 EA of Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) and 4.00 EA of Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985); their exact attachment geometry requires confirmation.
Check the fit and alignment of 1.00 EA of HL Fork (Product Number FK-9939) with the Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019) without assuming unspecified retention hardware.
